messages:
ana (PM): quick sync 1: customer asks for contractual remedies for BYOK unavailability and late audit exports. want a matrix we can attach to contracts. thoughts?

mike (Eng-Sec): current numbers: automated KMS failover ~4m in most regions, large export (100GB) ~30m on Dedicated. escrow/manual flows take longer and need ops sign-off.

sasha (Legal): prefer tiered service credits (not cash penalties). need clear SLA definitions, exclusions (legal hold, third-party KMS outage), and caps. avoid 'liquidated damages'.

devin (AE): fintech customer pushing for hard penalties. propose middle ground: tiered credits + documented audit artifacts + exec review path for exceptions.

tina (CS): common ask: "If BYOK unavailable >2h, provide export or temporary key with attestations." Escrow possible but ops-heavy.

mike (Eng-Sec): product work to map: KMS failover test harness + SLO dashboard; resumable export with priority lane; signed export manifests + chain-of-custody metadata; opt-in escrow API.

opsbot: Action: export-worker-v2 deployed 2025-09-12T16:02:00Z in us-west-2 :white_check_mark:

sasha (Legal): I'll draft a penalty matrix (credit tiers, caps, exclusions) by Fri. recommend caps like 10% per incident, 50% annual.

ana (ana (PM)): action list: 1) eng: estimate failover harness + dashboard (Q4 must-have) 2) eng: prototype resumable export (Q4 stretch) 3) legal/product: draft credit matrix (this week) 4) cs: collect top customer asks (EOD) 5) sec/ops: outline escrow ops and cost. mike please add a short sample export manifest for contract appendix.

mike (Eng-Sec): sample manifest (example):
```json
{"export_id":"exp_2025_09_12_001","tenant":"acme-payments","created_at":"2025-09-12T16:00:00Z","objects":["s3://rwd-exports/acme/part-0000.gz"],"sha256":"3b2f...","signed_by":"redwood-operator-42","coc":["req:customer@acme.com","app:ops@redwood.com"]}
```

ana (PM): perfect. syncing Fri 10am to review legal draft. :thumbsup:
